scope: Primary-source research notes, not local implementation or model-quality evidence

sources.title: ChopChop: A Programmable Framework for Semantically Constraining the Output of Language Models
sources.mechanism: AST program spaces and semantic pruning during generation; demonstrations include type safety and reference-program equivalence under rewrite rules.
sources.local_inference: Our stack-depth RPN grammar cannot ensure task arithmetic. A stronger semantic-pruner experiment needs explicitly public specifications; giving private benchmark references to the decoder would invalidate the comparison.
sources.not_established: Arbitrary Julia correctness, natural-language specification grounding, frontier intelligence, or our GPU throughput

sources.title: Type-Constrained Code Generation with Language Models
sources.mechanism: Type-prefix automata and inhabitation analysis constrain code before sampling; evaluated for synthesis, translation and repair.
sources.local_inference: A Julia adaptation should begin with a sound restricted typed language and fail closed on unsupported dispatch. JET diagnostics after a complete program are not equivalent to a completable-prefix type checker.
sources.not_established: A sound checker for unrestricted Julia dynamic dispatch or a completed local port

sources.title: TreeCoder: Systematic Exploration and Optimisation of Decoding and Constraints for LLM Code Generation
sources.mechanism: Decoding as tree search with configurable constraint and search components.
sources.local_inference: Any branching comparison must record total inference tokens, wall time and all attempts; a best-of-many success is not a fair pass-at-one replacement.
sources.not_established: Local reproduction or an equal-cost improvement on our Julia tasks

sources.title: RAR: Retrieval Augmented Retrieval for Code Generation in Low Resource Languages
sources.mechanism: Two-stage retrieval combining examples and documentation in low-resource-language code generation.
sources.local_inference: Source-example retrieval is distinct from our old docstring-only BM25 study. Alias grouping does not replace relevance selection, and neither is yet a demonstrated local model improvement.
sources.not_established: Performance on Julia or our Qwen runner

evaluation_guardrails: Do not feed private scorer formulas, expected arrays or hidden tests into generation or semantic constraints
Separate syntax validity, type safety, public-example agreement and independent functional correctness
Record uncompleted searches and all inference/solver costs; preserve matched controls and original failures
Check software and physical-device parity before claiming a shared-kernel implementation is qualified
